_comment: Trinket EP overrides. Sources: Wowhead BiS guides, community calcs on Wowhead comments, TBC theorycraft consensus. Values represent total effective EP including proc uptime for a typical 3-5 min raid fight.
_methodology: For on-use trinkets: passive_stat_EP + (use_effect_EP * uptime). For procs: effective_stat_equivalent from community calcs. Validated against Wowhead BiS rankings — if a guide ranks Trinket A over B, A must have higher EP than B for that spec.

28785._source: Wowhead comments: ~80 DPS at 33% crit = ~80 SP equiv. BiS for ele shaman (Wowhead Phase 1 guide). NOT in destro lock BiS list.

27683._source: 37 spell haste passive. Wowhead: BiS #1 for destro warlock. Haste is ~1.35 EP/rating for destro = 50 base. Proc uptime adds effective value.

29370._source: 43 passive SP + on-use 155 SP for 20s / 2 min CD. Effective avg: 43 + 155*(20/120) = 43 + 26 = 69 EP. Wowhead: BiS #2 for destro warlock, BiS #2 for ele shaman.

28789._source: 54 SP passive + on-use 170 SP for 10s / 2 min CD. Effective avg: 54 + 170*(10/120) = 54 + 14 = 68 EP.

19379._source: 44 SP + 16 spell hit. Pure stats. EP = 44*1.0 + 16*~1.9 = ~74 for hit-uncapped, ~44 for hit-capped. Wowhead: alternative when hit-capped.

29132._source: 32 spell hit passive + on-use 150 SP for 15s / 90s CD. Effective: 32*~1.9 + 150*(15/90) = 61 + 25 = 86 EP when hit-uncapped, ~42 when hit-capped.

28418._source: 30 spell crit passive + proc 225 SP for 10s on spell crit (45s ICD). Effective: 30*0.88 + 225*(10/45)*~0.6 uptime = 26 + 30 = ~56 EP for destro.

28223._source: 25 spell hit passive + on-use 175 SP for 20s / 2 min CD. Effective: 25*~1.9 + 175*(20/120) = 48 + 29 = 77 EP when hit-uncapped.

29179._source: 32 spell crit passive + on-use 150 SP for 15s / 90s CD. Effective: 32*0.88 + 150*(15/90) = 28 + 25 = 53 EP.

28830._source: 40 AP passive + proc 325 haste for 10s on melee crit. ~20% proc rate. BiS melee trinket Phase 1-3.

29383._source: 72 AP passive + on-use 278 AP for 20s / 2 min CD. Effective: 72 + 278*(20/120) = 72 + 46 = 118 AP equiv. At ~0.45 EP/AP = ~53 EP for most melee.

28034._source: 32 crit passive + proc 300 AP for 10s on melee crit (50s ICD).

28288._source: 64 AP passive + on-use 260 haste for 10s / 2 min CD.
